query: dfki dkt at semeval 2017 task 8 rumour detection and classification using cascading heuristics
sql:
SELECT corpus_id, title, abstract, year, citation_count
FROM Papers
WHERE title ILIKE '%semeval%'
  AND title ILIKE '%2017%'
  AND title ILIKE '%task 8%'
  AND (
    title ILIKE '%rumour%' OR
    title ILIKE '%rumor%'
  )
  AND (
    title ILIKE '%dfki%' OR
    abstract ILIKE '%dfki%'
  )
  AND (
    title ILIKE '%cascading%' OR
    abstract ILIKE '%cascading%'
  )
ORDER BY citation_count DESC, year DESC
LIMIT 100
